title: The anatomy of a lead
intent: Anatomy format, per the 2026-09-09 X-likes teardown: take one real thing apart, layer by layer, with the construction visible. The thing is Momentum's own lead path. An indigo paper-fibre thread is the lead's identity; it runs click -> landing page -> form and frays to nothing at the notification, after which a kraft thread carries an anonymous record on to the CRM. Drafted for internal review. Not client work, not scheduled, not published.

plateSource.provenance: Supplied by Dillon 2026-09-09 as visual direction. Licence NOT verified. Confirm before any use outside Momentum.

fillPlates._use: cream and kraft chip stock, caption card stock
the indigo thread: a real photographed indigo strand, cropped to a band

palette._source: sampled from the five reference plates; see STYLE-CONTRACT.md section 1

factCheck._rule: Every on-screen word is either pattern-level with no number attached, or sourced below. No client, competitor or vendor is named on screen.
factCheck.chain click -> landing page -> form -> n: 12_Brain/03_Concepts/2026-09-07 - Conversion match-back is the differentiator.md — the path a lead payload has to survive 'from form to inbox to report'.
factCheck.the break at the notification: Same note: 'The Zapier notifications that arrive in Gmail carry no lead data. They carry a link... There is nothing in the message to reconcile against a platform conversion.'
factCheck.the kraft thread onward to the CRM: Same note — the conversion is still counted downstream, it just has no name against it. Depicted as a neutral kraft thread, not the indigo identity thread.
Same note: '...precisely what the defect above breaks, and precisely what most agencies never notice is broken.' Pattern-level positioning claim, no statistic attached.
factCheck._notShown: The phone leg (no call tracking on the audited account, so calls stay anonymous) is true and recorded in the same note, but a second dead-end branch made the diagram noisy at this length. Cut deliberately, not overlooked.
12_Brain/03_Concepts/2026-09-07 - Conversion match-back is the differentiator.md — the lead payload does not survive the trip from form to inbox, so there is nothing left to reconcile. Pattern-level, no number attached.
